title: DatasetSeries v1
description: A statistical time series as harvested from an official provider (World Bank, FRED, Eurostat, ...). Statistical series are first-class evidence for checking quantitative claims; they are NOT documents (they are versioned, revisable, and numeric), so they carry their own contract rather than document-ingest-v1. Observations are vintaged by as_of so a claim check records which revision it ran against and is replayable. See docs/architecture/EVIDENCE_DATASETS_PLAN.md.

series_id.description: Provider-scoped, stable series identifier of the form '<provider>:<code>[:<geography>]', e.g. 'wb:SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS:DE'.

title.description: Human-readable series title, e.g. 'Unemployment, total (% of labor force) - Germany'.

unit.description: Unit of the observation values, normalized where possible (e.g. 'percent', 'usd', 'index', 'count'). Null when unknown.

geography.description: Geographic scope where applicable (ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, or a provider region code). Null for non-geographic series.

license.description: License/terms under which the series is published (e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0'). Rendered in the citation block.

as_of.description: Provider vintage of this harvest as milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Observations are keyed by (series_id, period, as_of) so revisions are retained.

source_url.description: URL the series was harvested from, for citation.

observations.description: The observed values, ordered by period ascending. May be empty (a series with no data yet).

period.description: Period label in a normalized form: 'YYYY' (annual), 'YYYY-Qn' (quarterly), 'YYYY-MM' (monthly), or 'YYYY-MM-DD' (daily/weekly).

value.description: Observed value, or null when the provider reports the period as missing.

metadata.description: Provider-specific fields that do not fit the core record (e.g. seasonal adjustment, indicator code, source note).

examples.title: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate) - Germany
